name: RC–B10–0219/2025 – After § 1 – Am 1
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the immediate risk of further repression by Lukashenka’s regime in Belarus – threats from the Investigative Committee
part_text: 1a. Condemns the extension, by six months, of the imprisonment in the Novopolotsk penal colony of Andrzej Poczobut, journalist and activist for the Union of Poles, and calls for his immediate release;
